items.title: Arizona Still Too Close To Call As Trump Supporters Protest TODAY
items.description:
Original description:
Hundreds of Trump supporters, some armed, gathered outside Arizona’s election center as votes continue to be counted there. NBC’s Gadi Schwartz reports for TODAY from Phoenix.
